items.note: User study comparing ideation with the FlexMind scaffold against ChatGPT (AI-configuration comparison, no no-AI arm); idea quality was higher with FlexMind; sample size and assignment not in the abstract.

Lancet Digital Health Comment with no real abstract (only an opening paragraph reachable); search notes say young researchers alone, LLMs alone, and LLM-assisted researchers generated clinical research ideas scored by 15 masked experts, with very few researchers (n=3 per notes); registered ChiCTR2500097263.

Comparative study (N=16) of StepIdeator, a step-by-step GenAI product-design tool, against a baseline; reports better idea externalization and creativity plus self-reported confidence and ownership; baseline condition and scoring method not stated.

Two teams of four designers ideated for four hours, one conventionally and one with ChatGPT-4 and Bard; experts rated idea creativity (on par) and the AI team produced about 1.67 times as many ideas; team-level comparison, abstract from the publisher landing page.

Wizard-of-Oz within-subjects study of story outlining with intrusive versus non-intrusive proactive suggestions from a human wizard posing as the AI; reports creativity gains and an agency trade-off; the AI was simulated, so the next stage should check whether it counts as generative AI; search notes give n=30.

Two-phase comparison (30 then 72 participants) of GUI and tangible card interfaces for LLM story writing against a traditional LLM approach; outcomes named are creative autonomy and emotional expression, likely partly self-reported.

Wordcraft user study in which participants wrote short stories with and without a GPT-3-based editor; the abstract reports qualitative co-writing experiences, so a scored output outcome may be absent.

Comparative user study in which young designers ideated with a fine-tuned text-generation mode versus a conventional search mode of IdeaSquares; findings reported are qualitative, so a scored creativity outcome may be absent.

Comparative experiment with 12 middle-school students using the LLM mentor agent Mentigo for creative problem solving, with five expert teachers evaluating; reports better engagement and creative outcomes; CHI 2025 version of arXiv 2409.14228.

ICIS 2024 paper that proposes a 2x2 between-subjects experiment varying breadth and depth of exploration in a custom GenAI ideation tool (Idea Hub), with ideation performance and dignity outcomes; the abstract says the design is proposed, so this may be research in progress with no data yet.
